unite_adi: UPPER SECONDARY-YEAR 10 (AFTER PREP)-LEVEL: B2.2 - THEME 2: CLASSROOM LIFE & LEARNING

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will design a project to share their personal learning adventure by focusing on several educational tools, learning styles, and study habits. They will begin by describing studying tools in the classroom such as smart boards and /or learning apps. They will explain how these tools can make learning easier and more enjoyable. They can explain and show one AI learning tool that is used by them. Later, they will talk about their own learning style whether they can learn best by seeing, hearing, or doing. They will provide examples of how they use techniques like mind mapping, summarising or teamwork for understanding lessons better by giving examples. Finally, they will create their own ''Study Success Plan'', by outlining useful habits like goal setting, taking breaks, and reviewing notes. They can present this plan through drawings, charts, or a short video. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme. Öğrenme-Öğretme Yaşantıları
bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''classroom life and learning with its components such as innovations in education and learning; personal ways and strategies of learning; study habits'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student in after prep year 10 of upper secondary school may know what innovations in education and learning; personal ways and strategies of learning; study habits mean in their as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in a foreign language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students in after prep year 10 of upper secondary school, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''classroom life and learning'' and also some necessary structures in English from the previous themes and/or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year, and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students in after prep year 10 of upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''classroom life and learning with its components such as innovations in education and learning; personal ways and strategies of learning; study habits'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss the poster and/or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and /or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To talk about educational innovations in English by using target vocabulary. Activity 1: Debate on Learning Innovations The teacher divides students into small groups and gives each group a topic related to innovations in education such as ''The role of AI in personalised learning'' or ''The impact of digital tools on study habits''. Each group prepares arguments for and against the topic by using target vocabulary such as ''critical thinking'', ''learning apps'', and/or ''digital literacy''. During the debate, students use the Passive voice (e.g. ''Learning outcomes are improved by integrating AI tools'') and suggestive structures (e.g. ''Shall we explore how digital tools advance self-paced learning?''). After the debate, each group writes a detailed summary of the discussion by focusing on the main idea and including at least three target phrases. The teacher gives some feedback on the use of language and new ideas. For home practice, the teacher asks the students to write a personal reflection on how they incorporate innovative strategies into their own learning. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To work on study habits in English through matching activities by using target vocabulary. Activity 1: Study Habits and Tools The teacher gives students a worksheet which includes pictures and a list of sentences such as ''Some notes are written by students in the lesson'', ''Mind maps are used to organise ideas'' and ''Some learning apps are downloaded for study''. Students match each sentence with the correct picture on the worksheet. After matching, each student makes a simple sentence by using target vocabulary or phrases such as ''Self-paced learning helps me study better''. The teacher gives feedback on their sentences for the accuracy and use of vocabulary. For homework, students are recommended to play a digital word game about such words to strengthen their vocabulary knowledge. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
